newsitem.title: LEBANON: Two Amal guerrillas killed in weekend fighting.
newsitem.headline: Two Amal guerrillas killed in weekend fighting.

text.p: Two guerrillas of Lebanon's Syrian-backed Amal Movement were killed in a weekend clash with Israeli forces in south Lebanon, the Shi'ite Moslem group said.

The said in a statement published by Beirut newspapers on Monday that its fighters clashed with the Israeli troops overnight Saturday after attacking their patrol near the village of Blat in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.

Amal, headed by parliament speaker Nabih Berri, sometimes attacks Israeli forces and allied militia in south Lebanon. The pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) leads the guerrilla war against the Israeli forces in a bid to drive them out.
